modules.name: Rikoshet Gate
modules.description: Tempo-synced rhythmic amplitude gate. Rate selects from 14 musical subdivisions (2 bars to 1/32, with dotted and triplet variants). Shape morphs hard square to raised cosine. Pulse Width sets duty cycle. Stereo Offset slips R-channel phase against L for width. Clock input drives sync; without clock it runs at the BPM knob's tempo. CV inputs for Rate, Shape, Depth, PW.

modules.name: Rikoshet PingPong
modules.description: Stereo ping-pong delay with cross-fed feedback. Tempo-synced (from clock input) or free (ms). Spread offsets the right channel time for tumbling repeats; Cross controls how much of the feedback crosses sides. Low/High Cut sit in the feedback path so repeats darken naturally. CV inputs for Time, Feedback, Mix.

modules.name: Rikoshet MultiTap
modules.description: 8-step pattern delay locked to a tempo-synced window. Per-tap level sliders distribute hits across the window; alternating L/R panning with Spread; level Decay tapers across taps; Feedback recirculates the whole pattern. CV inputs for window time, Decay, Feedback, Mix.

modules.name: Rikoshet Blend
modules.description: Stereo A/B crossfader with input drive and equal-power curve. Companion utility for blending parallel chains of Rikoshet effects, or dry/wet around a serial chain. CV inputs for Mix and Drive.
